source: 571 Key Details
target: 571 Notae Praecipuae

source: The Governor of the Sea’s residence hall opened into a labyrinth of rooms, its scarcity of windows allowing only a trickle of light despite the crimson moon’s glow.
target: Aedes Gubernatoris Maris in labyrinthum concluum patebat, quarum fenestrarum raritas solummodo tenuam lucis stillam concedebat, non obstante splendore lunaris rubrae.

source: The dimness cast a cloak of silence over the place.
target: Tenebrae velut pallium silentii super locum tegebant.

source: Even as the deputy host, clutching the coveted Ring of the Sea Queen, moved with caution, the floor still betrayed him with a faint echo.
target: Etiam dum vice hospitis, annulum desideratum Reginae Maris tenens, cum cautela movebatur, pavimentum tamen eum tenuo sonitu prodidit.

source: Lumian observed him heading towards the basement staircase, a sudden realization dawning upon him.
target: Lumian eum ad scalam subterraneam properantem observavit, atque subito lumen intellegentiae in eo apparuit.

source: Once in the basement, the deputy host could effortlessly switch the authentic Ring of the Sea Queen with a crafted counterfeit without alerting anyone.
target: Cum in subterraneo adfuisset, vice hospitis sine labore authenticum annulum Reginae Maris cum artificiose annulo falso commutare potuit, neminem admonens.

source: The other deputies were occupied in the hall, and the Governor of the Sea, undergoing physical modifications, had the Maidens of the Sea by his side.
target: Alii vice hospites in atrio occupabantur, et Gubernator Maris, mutationes corporales subiens, puellas maris ad latus habebat.

source: The sea spawn were scattered elsewhere.
target: Proles maris alibi dispersae erant.

source: Frowning, Lumian shot a sidelong glance at another deputy host.
target: Frons contrita, Lumian alium vice hospitis latere intuitum dedit.

source: He lowered his voice and addressed Jorge, the form Juan Oro had taken, in Intisian.
target: Vox demissa, Lumian Iorgem—formam quam Iuan Oro assumpsit—in lingua Intisiana allocutus est.

source: “Every year, during the vigil ritual, does a deputy host send the Ring of the Sea Queen alone to the basement, retrieving it an hour later?”
target: "Quotannis, in ritu vigiliae, num vice hospitis solus annulum Reginae Maris ad subterraneum mittit ac post unum horam recipit?"

source: He stressed the word “alone.”
target: Verbum "solus" sublineavit.

source: Juan Oro nodded subtly.
target: Iuan Oro leniter annuit.

source: “Yes. There’s no need for extra protection in this building…”
target: "Ita. In hoc aedificio non est opus praesidio addito…"

source: But just as Juan Oro was about to continue, he halted abruptly.
target: Sed, ut Iuan Oro pergere paratus esset, subito cessavit.

source: This presented a golden opportunity to swap the Ring of the Sea Queen unnoticed.
target: Hoc occasio aurea apparuit, ut annulum Reginae Maris inobservate commutaretur.

source: The fact that external enemies couldn’t breach the building didn’t mean the deputy hosts within were without their own problems!
target: Quod hostes externos aedificium penetrare non poterant, non significat vice hospites in eo nullas proprias difficultates habere!

source: Lumian wasted no time and turned to Juan Oro, uttering, “Should I follow, or will you take charge?”
target: Lumian pro viribus non moratus est et ad Iuan Oro se vertit, dicens: "Sequarne, an tu officio fungaris?"

source: Juan Oro regarded the matter gravely, rising from his seat and responding, “I’ll go.”
target: Iuan Oro rem graviter contemplatus, ex sede surgens respondit: "Eo."

source: Harnessing his abilities, he steadied himself and swiftly caught up with the deputy host.
target: Virtutibus suis utendo se firmavit atque celeriter vice hospitem adiit.

source: In a deep tone, he stated, “Let’s go together. I want to seize the chance to pay my respects to my ancestors.”
target: In voce profunda, dixit: "Eamus simul. Volo occasionem capere ut maioribus meis reverentiam tribuam."

source: The other deputy host raised no objections.
target: Alter vice hospitis nullae objectiones attulit.

source: As Lumian observed the two lighting their lanterns and descending into the basement, his mind instinctively filled in the upcoming sequence.
target: Dum Lumian eos, qui lanternas accendebant et in subterraneum descendebant, observabat, mens eius instinctive sequentiam futura praevidit.

source: Place the Ring of the Sea Queen on the decrepit stone platform… Offer prayers to the ancestors… Return to the surface… Re-enter and retrieve it an hour later…
target: Colloca annulum Reginae Maris in vetustam lapideam suggestum… Ora pro maioribus… Redi ad superficiem… Reintroe et post unam horam recipias…

source: During that hour, the Ring of the Sea Queen sits unguarded in the basement, vulnerable to any opportunistic interference…
target: Per eam horam, annulus Reginae Maris in subterraneo incustoditus sedet, vulnerabilis ad quamlibet interventionem opportunisticam…

source: If someone had concealed themselves there beforehand, swapping the genuine ring for a counterfeit would be a straightforward task…
target: Si quis ibi antea se celaverit, genuinum annulum pro falso commutare munus facile esset…

source: Certainly, infiltrating and concealing oneself in this location is no simple feat.
target: Certe, in hoc loco se infiltrare atque celare non est res simplex.

source: I can’t even do it; I could last a mere two minutes before being detected by the sea spawn…
target: Non possum quidem; tantum duo minuta vigeam antequam a prole maris detegarer.

source: The Ring of the Sea Queen has to be positioned on that worn stone platform.
target: Annulus Reginae Maris in illa lapsa lapideae suggestu poni debet.

source: Any deviations—deviations…
target: Quaecumque aberrationes—aberrationes…

source: With these thoughts swirling in his mind, Lumian suddenly recalled the transformations in the Lie earring when it rested on the weathered stone platform in the basement.
target: His cogitationibus in mente circumvolantibus, Lumian subito meminit mutationum in anulo "Lie" cum in lapsa lapideae suggestu subterraneo quiesceret.

source: The Seer pathway item had activated a pattern embodying an Apprentice and a Marauder, granting it the ability to siphon someone’s power that lasted half a month!
target: Res semitis "Seer" exemplar activavit, in quo repraesentabantur discipulus atque praedon, tribuens facultatem ut potentiam alicui subtraheret, quae per dimidium mensem duraret!

source: Lie could accomplish this feat, but what about the Ring of the Sea Queen?
target: "Lie" hoc assequi potuit, sed quid de Annulo Reginae Maris?

source: Though not an item of the Seer, Apprentice, or Marauder pathway, it had been meticulously crafted based on a ritual passed down by an Amon.
target: Quamquam non fuit pars itineris "Seer", discipuli aut praedonis, ex subtili artificio confecta, secundum ritum Amonis traditum.

source: Perhaps, over time, it could activate the unique characteristics of the basement, gradually assimilating with thieving qualities.
target: Forsitan, tempore, proprietates unicas subterranei activescere posset, paulatim virtutibus furandi coniungens.

source: Yes! Considering that the essence of the sea sacrificial ritual involves extracting power from the seal at the bottom of the sea and claiming it, the Ring of the Sea Queen, being a key item, should not only be capable of loosening the seal to a certain extent but also possess the power‐stealing ability.
target: Ita! Cum essentia rituum sacrificii maris includat potentiam ex sigillo in fundo maris extrahendam atque postea appropriandam, Annulus Reginae Maris, res clavis existens, debet non solum posse sigillum ad aliquo gradu solvere, sed etiam facultatem potentiam furandi habere.

source: It could distribute the gains among various participants in the ritual—
target: Potest utilitates distribuere inter variis ritu participantibus—

source: the host receiving the most, followed by the Maidens of the Sea as assistant hosts, and the deputy hosts and sailors gaining some within the ritual’s range, provided they possessed similar powers!
target: Hospes, qui plurimum accipit, deinde puellae maris ut hospites adiutores, atque vice hospites et nautae nonnullum in ambitu ritu capientes, dummodo potentias similes haberent!

source: In essence, Juan Oro and his companions’ understanding of the ring-making ritual is incomplete.
target: In essentia, intellectus Iuan Oro et comitum suorum de ritu annuli conficiendi imperfectus est.

source: The “paying homage to the ancestors” segment is integral and crucial.
target: Segmentum "maioribus honorem referendi" integrum atque cruciale est.

source: Without honoring the ancestors, the sea sacrificial ritual would merely open the seal without stealing the accumulated power.
target: Sine maiorum honore, rituum sacrificii maris tantum sigillum aperiret, potentiam accumulata non subtraheret.

source: Instead, it would erupt and disperse…
target: Contra, erupturum esset atque dispergeretur…

source: Lumian had just marveled at the mysticism’s terrifying complexity when a sudden alarm gripped him.
target: Lumian modo de terribili mysticismi complexitate admiratus erat, cum subito clamor eum obsedit.

source: He realized he had overlooked a pivotal detail.
target: Intellexit se rem cardinalem neglectum esse.

source: According to Madam Magician’s interpretation of the Ring of the Sea Queen’s functions and her speculations about the essence of the entire sea prayer ritual, the substitution of the genuine Ring of the Sea Queen with the fake ring customized by April Fool’s in Torres should have prevented the catastrophic phenomenon of the sea’s fury consuming the Governor of the Sea, all the deputy hosts, and some sailors in the subsequent ritual!
target: Secundum interpretationem Dominae Magicarum de functionibus Annuli Reginae Maris atque de speculationibus ejus circa essentiam totius rituum precationis maris, substitutio genuini Annuli Reginae Maris cum annulo falso ab April Fool’s in Torres more confecto, debuisset praecavere phenomenon catastrophicum furoris maritimi, qui Gubernatorem Maris, omnes vice hospites, atque aliquos nautas in ritu subsequente consumeret!

source: The fake ring hadn’t undergone the initial ring-making ritual, leaving its patterns, symbols, and structure devoid of the necessary mysticism characteristics.
target: Annulus falsus initium ritu annuli conficiendi non passa fuit, relinquens figuras, symbola, et structuram, quae proprietatibus mysticis necessariis carebant.

source: Even if the Governor of the Sea recited the prescribed words, he couldn’t infuse energy into it to open the seal!
target: Etiamsi Gubernator Maris verba praescripta recitasset, in eum energiam infundere ad sigillum aperiendum non potuit!

source: As a complete counterfeit, it shouldn’t have triggered any phenomena.
target: Ut falsum completum, nullum phaenomenon excitare debebat.

source: However, due to its incapacity to extract the amassed power, the sea area would experience more shipwrecks, and the weather would deteriorate.
target: Attamen, ex eius impotentia potentiam cumulativam extrahendi, zona maris plura naufragia ferret, et tempestas deterioraretur.

source: To align with the events of the previous year, the fake ring thrown by the Governor of the Sea had to complete the first part of the ring-making ritual.
target: Ad eventus anni praeteriti congruendos, annulus falsus a Gubernatore Maris iactus primam partem ritu annuli conficiendi perficere debebat.

source: Still, without being placed in the basement to honor the ancestor, it could only partially open the seal, unable to extract and monopolize the gathered power.
target: Nisi in subterraneo ad maiorum honorem collocaretur, solum parcie sigillum aperire potuit, atque potentiam cumulativam extrahi et monopolizari non potuit.

source: This incomplete process led to a sudden eruption, causing the sea to “rage”!
target: Hic processus incompletus ad repentinam eruptionem duxit, quod mare "iratum" efficiebat!

source: Lumian’s eyes narrowed slightly.
target: Lumiani oculi leviter angustati sunt.

source: As a Conspirer, he had seized the core of the matter.
target: Ut conspirator, nucleum rei apprehendit.

source: Two Rings of the Sea Queen were on the ship, but both were fakes.
target: Duo Annuli Reginae Maris in nave erant, sed ambo falsi erant.

source: The ring brought by the deputy host to the ritual ship was also a forgery.
target: Annulus a vice hospitis ad navem caerimonialem delatus quoque falsum erat.

source: In fact, the authentic Ring of the Sea Queen hadn’t made an appearance during last year’s sea prayer ritual!
target: Revera, annulus authenticus Reginae Maris anno praeterito in ritu precationis maris non apparuit!

source: The genuine Ring of the Sea Queen, which had undergone the entire ring‐making ritual as per the Fisheries Guild’s knowledge, hadn’t been placed on the stone platform in the basement to fulfill the ritual of honoring the ancestors.
target: Annulus genuinus Reginae Maris, qui totum ritu annuli conficiendi iuxta scientiam Collegii Piscarii passa est, in suggestu lapideo subterraneo ad ritum maiorum honorandum non positus est.

source: Consequently, it was also a sham—a counterfeit ring lacking the most crucial effect!
target: Ergo etiam mendacium erat—annulus falsus, effectum maximi carens!

source: The deputy host who had taken the Ring of the Sea Queen into the basement and retrieved it last year might also be part of the problem!
target: Vice hospitis, qui annulum Reginae Maris in subterraneum delatus et anno praeterito receptus est, fortasse etiam pars quaestionis erat!

source: The peripheral members affiliated with April Fool’s weren’t considered trustworthy.
target: Membra lateralia cum April Fool’s affiliata non habebantur fideles.

source: Their actions likely didn’t disrupt the overall plan.
target: Eorum agendi ratio verisimiliter consilium universale non perturbavit.

source: The fake ring concealed in the lamb’s stomach and the Bard’s performance likely served as preparations for subsequent investigations, camouflaging vital clues.
target: Annulus falsus, in ventre agni celatus, atque spectaculum Bardi, verisimiliter praeparationes ad investigationes ulteriores ferebant, occultantes claves vitales.

source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, Juan Oro and the deputy host returned to the hall.
target: Dum cogitationes Lumiani celeriter erant, Iuan Oro et vice hospitis in atrium redierunt.

source: “It’s on the stone platform,” whispered the president of the Fisheries Guild, masquerading as Jorge, to Lumian.
target: "In suggestu lapideo est," susurravit praeses Collegii Piscarii, sub specie Iorgi, ad Lumian.

source: Lumian refocused his attention and casually inquired, “Who was responsible for sending the Ring of the Sea Queen to the basement last year?”
target: Lumian attentionem refecit atque leviter interrogavit: "Quis annulum Reginae Maris ad subterraneum anno praeterito misit?"

source: “I don’t know. Without any special arrangements, anyone can do it. The four deputy hosts in the hall last year died in the sea’s rage when the ritual failed.” Juan Oro, sensing Lumian’s suspicion, clarified.
target: "Nescio. Sine aliquibus ordinationibus specialibus, quisquis id facere potest. Quattuor vice hospites in atrio anno praeterito in ira maris perierunt, cum ritu naufragavit," Iuan Oro, Lumiani suspicere sentiens, explanavit.

source: Dead? Unlikely… Lumian lacked the corresponding item for spirit channeling and didn’t have time to search for it.
target: "Mortui? Improbabile… Lumian rem idoneam ad spiritum canalizandum deesse sensit neque tempus in quaerendo habuit."

source: All he could do was ask, “Which one of them was familiar with the ring‐making ritual and knows the details of the Ring of the Sea Queen?”
target: Omnia quae ei possent fieri erant, rogare: "Quis eorum ritu annuli conficiendi peritus fuit et singula Annuli Reginae Maris novit?"

source: “None of them; it was their first time serving as deputy hosts.” Juan Oro shook his head. “Besides, as I said, those who know these secrets are still alive.”
target: "Nullus ex illis; primum tempus fuerunt in munere vice hospitum." Iuan Oro caput concussit. "Praeterea, ut dixi, qui has arcanas norunt, adhuc vivunt."

source: If the deputy host wasn’t Ultraman… Then who was it? Lumian’s mind raced as he arrived at a conclusion.
target: Si vice hospitis non erat Ultraman… Ergo quis erat? Mens Lumiani celeriter volitavit, ad solutionem perveniens.

source: It was Mad Lady!
target: Erat Domina Insana!

source: Similar to Bard, she utilized the same technique to alter her appearance.
target: Similiter Bardo, eam eandem technicam ad formam mutandam usus est.

source: With Ultraman’s assistance, she assumed the guise of a deputy host, completing the final step in creating the Ring of the Sea Queen.
target: Cum auxilio Ultraman, speciem vice hospitis assumpsit, gradum ultimum in creatione Annuli Reginae Maris perficiens.

source: Then, she boarded the ceremonial ship with it.
target: Deinde, cum eo, in navem caerimonialem conscendit.

source: Lumian had been puzzled by how Mad Lady could locate the special sea and rescue Bard accurately and in time.
target: Lumian mirabatur quomodo Domina Insana mare speciale invenire et Bardum tempore ac recte servare posset.

source: Now, he had the answer.
target: Nunc responsum habebat.

source: Mad Lady was present on the ceremonial ship, right beside Bard.
target: Domina Insana in navem caerimonialem praesens erat, prope Bardum.

source: There was no need for coordinated locations or timing!
target: Non erant necessariae coordinationes locorum aut temporum!

source: Initially suspecting Mad Lady to collaborate with Bard, Lumian now realized that Bard worked with Mad Lady, providing assistance in case of unexpected developments and shouldering the responsibility of misleading investigations.
target: Primum suspicatus, putans Domina Insanam cum Bardo collaborare, nunc Lumian intellexit Bardum cum Domina Insana cooperari, auxilium ferens in casibus repentinis eventuum atque onus contra investigationes fallaces suscipit.

source: “Dammit, Faceless abilities are so annoying. April Fool’s is so annoying!”
target: "Eheu, facultates 'Faceless' tam infestantes sunt. 'April Fool’s' etiam valde infestans est!"

source: Lumian’s emotions fluctuated as he struggled to contain his emotions as he cursed.
target: Affectus Lumiani fluctuabant, dum se continere conabatur, maledictus.

source: Relying on his Ascetic trait, he restrained himself from erupting.
target: Indolem asceticam amplectens, se ab eruptione cohibuit.

source: More importantly, while he had unraveled the issues with the sea prayer ritual from last year, the identities of Ultraman and the forthcoming plans of April Fool’s remained elusive.
target: Praeterea, cum quaestiones rituum precationis maris anni praeteriti elucidaverat, identitates Ultraman et consilia ventura April Fool’s adhuc incerta manebant.

source: The night passed in silence.
target: Nox silentio transivit.

source: On an out-of-fashion sailboat in the harbor, Charname, sporting a short, round‑rimmed felt hat, emerged from the cabin and approached Nolfi, who stood at the edge of the deck.
target: In navicula velae obsoleta in portu, Charname, pileum breveum et rotundum habens, ex cella emersit et Nolfi accessit, quae in margine navis stabat.

source: Charname inquired, “Can we enter those special waters if we set off now?”
target: Charname interrogavit: "Possumusne in has aquas speciales intrare, si nunc proficiscamur?"

source: Nolfi nodded, responding, “Yes, the stars will align in a specific pattern after midnight.”
target: Nolfi annuit, respondens: "Ita, astra post medium noctis in certo ordine congruentur."

source: Following Lumian’s instructions, she and Batna had rented a boat for a few days from other ports along the same coastline.
target: Secundum praecepta Lumiani, illa et Batna naviculam paucorum dierum ex aliis portubus iuxta eandem oram locaverunt.

source: Charname chuckled, saying, “Then let’s set off!”
target: Charname subridens dixit: "Ergo proficiscamur!"

source: Observing the surprised and puzzled expressions of Nolfi and Batna, he explained, “If we follow the Governor of the Sea’s ceremonial ship, we’ll undoubtedly be discovered by the Fisheries Guild. Setting off an hour or two later would be meaningless. Therefore, we’ll go ahead of time and hide there, patiently waiting for an opportunity!”
target: Observans vultus Nolfi et Batna insperatos et perplexos, explicavit: "Si navem caerimonialem Gubernatoris Maris sequamur, certo ab Collegio Piscario inveniemur. Proficiscere post unam vel duas horas inutilis erit. Ergo, ante tempus proficiscemur atque ibi nos abscondemus, opportunitatem patienter exspectantes!"

source: Although Nolfi didn’t understand the nature of the opportunity Charname referred to, she didn’t inquire.
target: Quamquam Nolfi naturam opportunitatis a Charname allatae non intellexit, quaerere non audebat.

source: She responded with anticipation, “Okay.”
target: Ea cum exspectatione respondit: "Bene."

source: Charname then turned to Batna.
target: Deinde, Charname ad Batnam se converterit.

source: “Are you joining us? It will be very dangerous.”
target: "Ne nobiscum iungis? Valde periculosum erit."

source: Batna’s expression fluctuated. After more than ten seconds, he declared, “I’m going!”
target: Aspectus Batnae fluctuavit. Post paulo plus quam decem secundas, declaravit: "Eo!"

source: Charname clicked his tongue but remained silent.
target: Charname linguam frotavit, sed tacitus mansit.

source: At that moment, Nolfi frowned, glancing at other parts of the deck, and asked, “What about the sailors here? We can’t leave the sea without them, and they can’t handle too much danger.”
target: Illo momento, Nolfi fronem contraxit, alias partes navis intuens, et rogavit: "Quid de nautae hic? Mare sine illis relinquere nequeunt, nec nimium pericula sustinere possunt."

source: Charname chuckled.
target: Charname subridens risum edidit.

source: “Don’t worry, we have sailors who can handle danger.”
target: "Noli sollicitus esse, nautae habemus qui periculum ferre possunt."

source: As soon as he finished speaking, he half‑turned, raising his right hand to the third level of the cabin.
target: Ut loquendi finem pervenisset, ad dimidium conversus, dextram manum ad tertium cellae gradum levavit.

source: He clasped his index finger and thumb into a ring and extended his other three fingers.
target: Digitum indicem et pollicem in anulo coartavit, et tres reliquos digitos protendit.

source: Soon, the captain, first mate, second mate, and all the sailors emerged, their eyes tightly shut.
target: Statim, capitaneus, primus adiutor navis, secundus adiutor, et omnes nautae apparuerunt, oculi arcte clausi.

source: Like sleepwalkers, they lined up and walked down the gangway toward the docks.
target: Velut sonambuli, ordinati se congregaverunt atque per navis scala descendentes ad molas pervenerunt.

source: Batna and Nolfi’s eyes froze, as if trapped in a terrifying dream.
target: Oculi Batnae et Nolfi congelaverunt, quasi in somnio terribili captivis essent.
